entries.rationale: Request IDs/actions select ordered review results after writableContext authorizes the server-resolved repository. Each executeReview uses the exact repository/workspace proposal query before Git mutation; expected-head enforcement precedes projection and locked bookkeeping. Cross-tenant, role, action and stale-head contracts are recorded in docs/qa/2026-10-06-security-contracts.md. Reviewed in #857; retained by full main CodeQL run 37411135910.
